label: token right after an early z (z at position 0 or 1)
explanation: Fires only in the original phase at t=1 or t=2, when the previous input was z (i.e. z was the first or second original token). Precision 1.0 on dev, mass recall ~1.0. Magnitude is highest at t=1 (z as first token, ~0.95-1.0 of max regardless of the current token), and lower at t=2 (z second, ~0.6-0.9). A small residual of weak activations follows j at early positions, and a few at t=3. Never fires at t=0, at the delimiter, during the copy phase, or after a z that appears later in the sequence.

issues: Minor: the misses (1914 test steps, recall 0.946) are not scattered. Most are a consistent class: t=1 after a first token j, with activation about 0.00 of max. They hold roughly 0.0% of the activation mass (mass recall 0.9998), so they are near-threshold leakage rather than a real counterexample class. A few weak ones (0.03-0.05) occur at t=3 after z at position 2.
Minor: 'whatever the current token is' is slightly loose. Every top activation at 1.00 has the current token '3'. Other tokens at t=1 still reach about 0.95-0.99, so the claim holds in substance.

All factual claims check out on dev and test. Precision is 1.0 with 0 false positives. The feature never fires at t=0, at the delimiter, in the copy phase, or at t>=4. On dev, 57% of activation mass is at t=1 and 43% at t=2. t=1 activations are about 0.95-1.0 of max and t=2 activations about 0.6-0.9 (including the 'z z' case, where t=2 reaches 0.68).
